evidence: Lessons: (1) real data showed 6/6 drafted comments kept — precision looks perfect while recall is unknown, which is why the labelled set matters; (2) review noise reaches the team through the existing committed weekly summaries, keeping the MCP server read-only; (3) harvested diffs are client code — the default output is outside the repo; (4) biome --write on a folder touches unrelated files (ci-templates.ts again) — format named files only; (5) a docs slice without lint in its verification let a format error through (spec-drift-roadmap fixed).
